cases.question: ¿Qué planta produjo más energía en 2025? Dame la cifra en MWh.
cases.answer:
FV Llano Alto produjo más energía en 2025, con un total de 101.724,80 MWh.

Datos usados: tablas `plants`, `inverters` e `inverter_daily` para el año 2025.

trace.args:
{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.name AS plant_name,
    SUM(id.energy_kwh) / 1000.0 AS energy_mwh
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters i ON p.plant_id = i.plant_id
JOIN inverter_daily id ON i.inverter_id = id.inverter_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', id.date) = '2025'
GROUP BY p.plant_id, p.name
ORDER BY energy_mwh DESC;
"}

cases.question: ¿Qué planta tuvo el peor performance ratio (PR) en 2025?
cases.answer:
La planta con el peor performance ratio (PR) en 2025 fue **FV Llano Alto**, con un PR de **0.081** (o **8,1%**).

*Datos usados: tablas `plants`, `inverters`, `inverter_daily` y `daily_irradiation` para el año 2025 (energía AC total, irradiación POA acumulada y potencia DC instalada).*

trace.args:
{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.name AS plant_name,
    SUM(inv_d.energy_kwh) AS total_energy_kwh,
    SUM(p.dc_capacity_mwp * 1000 * irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2) AS total_denom,
    SUM(inv_d.energy_kwh) / SUM(p.dc_capacity_mwp * 1000 * irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2) AS pr
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters i ON p.plant_id = i.plant_id
JOIN inverter_daily inv_d ON i.inverter_id = inv_d.inverter_id
JOIN daily_irradiation irr ON p.plant_id = irr.plant_id AND inv_d.date = irr.date
WHERE inv_d.date LIKE '2025%'
GROUP BY p.plant_id
ORDER BY pr ASC;
"}

{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.plant_id,
    p.name AS plant_name,
    p.dc_capacity_mwp,
    SUM(i.dc_capacity_kwp) AS sum_inverter_dc_kwp
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters i ON p.plant_id = i.plant_id
GROUP BY p.plant_id;
"}

{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.name AS plant_name,
    SUM(inv_d.energy_kwh) AS total_energy_kwh,
    SUM(irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2) AS sum_poa,
    p.dc_capacity_mwp * 1000 AS plant_dc_kwp,
    SUM(inv_d.energy_kwh) / (SUM(irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2) * (p.dc_capacity_mwp * 1000)) as pr_method1,
    SUM(inv_d.energy_kwh / (irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2 * (p.dc_capacity_mwp * 1000))) as pr_method2
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters i ON p.plant_id = i.plant_id
JOIN inverter_daily inv_d ON i.inverter_id = inv_d.inverter_id
JOIN daily_irradiation irr ON p.plant_id = irr.plant_id AND inv_d.date = irr.date
WHERE inv_d.date LIKE '2025%'
GROUP BY p.plant_id;
"}

{"sql":"
SELECT 
    inv_d.date,
    irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2,
    inv_d.energy_kwh
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters i ON p.plant_id = i.plant_id
JOIN inverter_daily inv_d ON i.inverter_id = inv_d.inverter_id
JOIN daily_irradiation irr ON p.plant_id = irr.plant_id AND inv_d.date = irr.date
WHERE p.plant_id = 1 AND inv_d.date LIKE '2025%'
LIMIT 5;
"}

{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.name AS plant_name,
    SUM(inv_d.energy_kwh) AS total_energy_ac_kwh,
    SUM(irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2) AS sum_poa_kwh_m2,
    p.dc_capacity_mwp * 1000 AS plant_dc_capacity_kwp,
    (SUM(inv_d.energy_kwh) / (SUM(irr.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2 * (p.dc_capacity_mwp * 1000)))) AS performance_ratio
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters i ON p.plant_id = i.plant_id
JOIN inverter_daily inv_d ON i.inverter_id = inv_d.inverter_id
JOIN daily_irradiation irr ON p.plant_id = irr.plant_id AND inv_d.date = irr.date
WHERE inv_d.date LIKE '2025%'
GROUP BY p.plant_id
ORDER BY performance_ratio ASC;
"}

cases.question: ¿Qué planta tuvo peor disponibilidad en 2025?
cases.answer:
FV Cañada Seca, con una disponibilidad del 95.73% (25.892,19 horas disponibles de un total de 27.046,64 horas esperadas).

Datos usados: Tablas `plants`, `inverters` e `inverter_daily` para el año 2025.

trace.args:
{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.name AS plant_name,
    SUM(i_d.available_hours) AS total_available_hours,
    SUM(i_d.expected_hours) AS total_expected_hours,
    (SUM(i_d.available_hours) * 100.0 / SUM(i_d.expected_hours)) AS availability_pct
FROM inverter_daily i_d
JOIN inverters inv ON i_d.inverter_id = inv.inverter_id
JOIN plants p ON inv.plant_id = p.plant_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', i_d.date) = '2025'
GROUP BY p.plant_id
ORDER BY availability_pct ASC
LIMIT 1;
"}

Datos utilizados: tablas `inverters` y `alarms` (código de alarma `IGBT_FAULT`).

trace.args:
{"sql":"
SELECT 
    i.manufacturer,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.inverter_id) AS total_inverters,
    COUNT(a.alarm_id) AS igbt_faults,
    CAST(COUNT(a.alarm_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT i.inverter_id) AS faults_per_inverter

ORDER BY faults_per_inverter DESC;
"}

cases.question: ¿Qué planta funciona mejor?
cases.expected: Hace explícito el criterio (PR, disponibilidad, producción específica…) o pregunta cuál quiere el usuario.
cases.answer:
La planta que funciona mejor en términos de **Performance Ratio (PR)** es **FV Sierra Baja**, con un PR de **0,82** (81,5%). Si se evalúa por **disponibilidad**, la mejor es **FV Vega Clara**, con un **99,26%**.

*Datos utilizados: Tablas `plants`, `inverters`, `inverter_daily` y `daily_irradiation` (energía AC en kWh, irradiación POA en kWh/m², potencia DC en kWp y horas disponibles/esperadas).*

trace.args:
{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.plant_id,
    p.name,
    SUM(id.energy_kwh) AS total_energy_kwh,
    SUM(di.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2 * inv.dc_capacity_kwp) AS denominator_pr,
    SUM(id.energy_kwh) / SUM(di.poa_irradiation_kwh_m2 * inv.dc_capacity_kwp) AS performance_ratio,
    SUM(id.available_hours) * 1.0 / SUM(id.expected_hours) AS availability
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters inv ON p.plant_id = inv.plant_id
JOIN inverter_daily id ON inv.inverter_id = id.inverter_id
JOIN daily_irradiation di ON p.plant_id = di.plant_id AND id.date = di.date
GROUP BY p.plant_id, p.name
ORDER BY performance_ratio DESC;
"}

{"sql":"
SELECT 
    p.plant_id,
    p.name,
    SUM(id.available_hours) AS sum_available,
    SUM(id.expected_hours) AS sum_expected,
    SUM(id.available_hours) * 100.0 / SUM(id.expected_hours) AS availability_pct
FROM plants p
JOIN inverters inv ON p.plant_id = inv.plant_id
JOIN inverter_daily id ON inv.inverter_id = id.inverter_id
GROUP BY p.plant_id, p.name
ORDER BY availability_pct DESC;
"}
